changes: Added HostNativeMemoryContext with GPU-VA range resolution, functional read/write, page leases, dispatch authorization, and explicit cleanup.
Reused HostGPUMemoryState, HostGPUQueueState, HostGPUSignalState, and HostGPUDispatchState in a standalone gfx950 pinned XOR parity executable before the USE_X86_ISA gate.
Added runtime HSACO metadata probe evidence for the two pinned gfx950 images and retained the Triton extension/launch boundary as not supported.
limitations: CP-0016 proves functional memory/dispatch parity and metadata recognition only. It does not map PT_LOAD segments, apply relocations, construct dynamic AQL/kernarg, submit a real queue, connect HSAPacketProcessor/GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit, or execute an ISA kernel.
The standalone parity ELF is not a complete host-native GPU pipeline; the remaining Process/ThreadContext/SE-TLB dependency is explicitly retained as the next implementation boundary.

The two runtime probes are metadata-only and report execution_supported=false. Triton end-to-end remains 0/1 because the pinned extension is blocked by an LLVM TableGen lock mismatch and the environment has no HIP runtime/device.
No hardware, timing, performance, HIP, OpenCL, PyTorch, vLLM, or model claim is made.

argv: Implement bounded PT_LOAD mapping, native translation, descriptor/entry validation, and dynamic AQL/kernarg parity over the CP16 host-native context
next_action.expected: A locked zero-relocation gfx950 image is validated, mapped into host-native simulated pages, bound to a descriptor and dynamic AQL/kernarg record, and compared against the existing gem5 reference without x86 CPU/system objects or CPU fallback.
prerequisites: CP-0016 root checkpoint is accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.
Both CP16 child commits and EV-0040/EV-0041 remain immutable.
The CP13 fixed-record transport and existing code-object parser remain the only ABI authority.
The adapter must retain atomic rollback and reject unsupported relocations/targets before any mapping or publish.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0016 accepted and preserve the standalone parity executable, VEGA_X86 oracle, and metadata-only Triton probe if PT_LOAD, translation, or dynamic AQL validation fails.

The rebuilt memory, dispatch, queue, and signal tests pass 8/12/12/12 cases; the retained CP15 eight-binary compatibility matrix remains green.
